d: In a single week, Microsoft's email went down worldwide, every US flight was grounded, JPMorgan Chase and Zelle stalled, Apple's iCloud and App Store crashed, and the NSA reported trouble on its classified network. Many Americans suspected a cyberattack. The US government says these were technical failures caused by upgrades, patches and old equipment, including a single router in Arkansas that brought air traffic to a halt. Meanwhile, real hackers were at work quietly, planting card-stealing code on websites run by nearly 180 organisations through Optimizely. Vrinda Tulsian explains.
